style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm cozy children's underwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream background #FAF3E3, warm orange accent #F2A65A, misty blue secondary #A9C3DC, warm brown text #7A6248 and clean white #FFFFFF for packshots; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle front key and soft contact shadows; rounded friendly sans-serif; soft cloud-shaped badge outlines with thin-line care icons; clean knitwear photography mixed with minimal cloud-panel infographic elements; stable folded garment presentation with unchanged silhouette; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no cartoon character mascots, no mismatched icon styles.
